analysis:
The PR modifies only docs/architecture/security/attestation.md. No code or enforcement logic changed. Only part of the diff was visible: base lines 262-541 and head lines 1-262. The mid-section of the head file (head lines 263 onward) was not supplied, so the head-side text is incomplete. Base text appears to match the head's later lines in the supplied range. The reviewed changes are documentation realignments.

Head lines 10-14, 16, 25, 114 and the metadata-bearing lines 48-78 and 82-106 say that centralized authorization, receipt policy and freshness/renewal timings are owned by darkbloom-platform and supersede the retained coordinator snapshot. They also say that missing recurring receipt/risk evidence does not block basic serving, but withholds reward/MDM-removal readiness. They state that retries and renewals cannot extend proof or administrative ceilings, and that failed reads cannot extend them. This matches the canonical header (TB-011, T-053, T-057) and does not weaken a documented control. The docs also say these are the linked platform revision's semantics, not a claim of deployment.

Head lines 48-78 describe provider-side connection control. Replies use an originating-socket AppAttestShadowReply capability that rechecks the transport, so late callbacks cannot send an old proof over a replacement connection. Local Apple success is not coordinator acceptance. No retry, grace period or trusted lifetime is added. This is consistent with T-053.

Head line 71-78 covers the endpoint-resumption candidate, which proves custody of the fixed process key with a fresh socket nonce, grants no local authorization, and does nothing without a matching platform implementation. Head lines 25 and 29-37 describe qualification generations, CandidateCDHash unique binding, and the bounded ED-clear extension parsing that happens only after chain/nonce/signature verification. These are consistent with T-054.

No new attack surface or invalidated threat assumptions found. Items for the next pass: the documentation now defers receipt/freshness policy to an external pinned platform revision (20b82164...) that was not supplied. The cross-references (../../reference/provider-authorization.md, protocol-messages.md anchors) were not verified here. Retained coordinator/ paths cited in the doc may predate the policy split.
